utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re gathering donations and volunteers this week — I can swing by and tell you the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah? Can you confirm when it’s happening and where to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — I’ll check the flyer and confirm the dates and drop-off spot for you. I should have the details shortly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still planning to help with the repair drive, and I’ll let the others know what we need next.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Vik. Just let me know what you need and I’ll try to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what’s still needed and pass it along. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Around 3 should work fine — I’ll be here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll swing by around 3.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help however I can. What’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we’re still sorting the supply list, but I’m checking what’s already on hand and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — I can help check what’s already on hand if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after the school pickup, if that helps. Just tell me what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would help a lot — how about around 3:30? I’ll send you the details for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 works for me — I’ll head over after pickup. Send the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: what needs fixing, and when are we heading over?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, simple’s best — I think it’s just the loose railing and that squeaky door. We can head over this afternoon if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: This afternoon works for me. Let’s make a quick list and go over once, then we can be done.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I can spread the word to everyone on the block and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be a big help, thanks. I’m just trying to make sure we have enough people and the timing works out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask around the block and see who’s free, then I’ll let you know what timing works best.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is happening soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — I could really use help making a quick signup list and checking in with neighbors who might need small repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help with that — I’ll make the signup list and check in with folks nearby. Just point me to the neighbors you want me to ask.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t checked the repair drive details yet—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s mostly the little things—loose handles, a squeaky hinge or two, and any lamp or outlet that isn’t working right. If you want, I can jot down what we hear from the neighbors and keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would help a lot—please jot them down, and I’ll check each one before we start fixing anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — I can swing by a bit later and keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — later is better. I’ll have it ready and keep it discreet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if the repair drive needs any tools, I’ve got a few you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you have a screwdriver set I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got a screwdriver set you can borrow — I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive location details—where’s it set up, and what time should I note?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s set up over by the community center, and I’d note it for 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community center at 10 a.m. I’ll note that down.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I’m mostly hoping to gather a few extra tools and see what else folks might need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my toolbox and see what I’ve got to spare. If you want, I can also help make a quick list of what folks still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure the timing and pickup details are sorted first. If we know who’s handling what, I’ll feel a lot better about it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, that makes sense — can you confirm the pickup time and who’s bringing the tools?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check the pickup time, but I still need to know who’s bringing the tools before I’m fully set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—want me to connect the folks who can bring tools with the folks who can organize supplies?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please—that would be a huge help. I’ll handle the organizing side and keep you posted on what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to the tool folks and get everyone linked up. Just send me the updated supplies list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll swing by late and help load whatever you still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll make a quick list and set the extra supplies aside for you. See you late — and thanks for helping load up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already. If you want, I can tell you what folks are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess—please do. I’m trying to keep track of what we still need for the school drop-off and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: So far I’ve heard snacks, a couple of tool kits, and one person offering to help coordinate the school times. I’ll keep an ear out for anything else and tell you right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — could you help me by checking in with a few neighbors and noting what repairs they need? If you can, also let me know which ones are urgent so I can organize the list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely — I’ll check in with a few neighbors and flag the urgent repairs for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the drop-off table?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the drop-off table.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together the repair drive invite list now—want me to add you, Nell?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please add me — I’d appreciate any updates you can pass along too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you and keep you posted on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the repair drive location yet, but I’m happy to keep track of it if you tell me where it is.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. I’ll jot it down once I find the location and let you know clearly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Eli — just send me the location when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, what kind of repairs are we collecting for in the drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I want to double-check the details before I say for sure. Do you mean household repairs, bikes, or something else for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I mean household repairs—things like leaky faucets, broken cabinets, or patching walls. What’s the drive covering?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like a good turnout for the repair drive — what do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Could you tell folks we still need a cordless drill and a few extra screwdrivers? I keep misplacing mine, so any help would be a relief.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll pass that along while I’m out. A cordless drill and a few extra screwdrivers, got it.
